Cash consideration of $105.00 per share of Common Stock at the Closing, with additional treatment for Company equity awards (cash-out or stock-for-stock conversions via an Equity Award Exchange Ratio for RSUs, and cash-out for options) and DGCL Section 262 appraisal rights for Dissenting Shares.
Cash per share: $105.00 per share; no CVRs are described in the provided text. The merger contemplates other forms of consideration including Converted Shares (subsidiaries’ shares converted into Surviving Corporation stock) and various equity-award related adjustments (e.g., RSU awards with an Equity Award Exchange Ratio and cash-out elements for options/RSUs/PSUs) as further described in the related sections.
Equity Award Exchange Ratio applies to RSU Awards; there is no fixed exchange ratio for ordinary Company shares.
